title: Start here
intro: Storybook is the design-system catalogue for the discocan admin. Explore the shared foundations, patterns, shell and PrimeNG coverage.
review: Use Language, Theme, Brand, Density and the viewport toolbar to review shared components. Check keyboard behavior and the Accessibility panel.
report: Send the full story title, explain what looks wrong or what you expected, and attach a screenshot. Include the language, theme, brand, density and viewport.
buildingBlocksNote: Design System contains the shared layout, colours, controls and panels used across the admin. Review screens in the running dev app with Fleet demo data.
